bds.lede: Trump said he will defer to an appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate bomb-making material at an Iowa plant.
rows: Trump said he will defer to an appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate bomb-making material at an Iowa plant.
President Donald Trump says he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether to proceed with detonating degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.

President Donald Trump on Monday said he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.
The U.S. Army plans to detonate 68 drums of lead azide in Iowa despite local leaders and residents raising concerns.
Trump said he wants the OK from the federal appeals court and incoming Iowa governor to proceed.
The army says it has moved the detonation to Wednesday to allow for "optimal weather conditions", as public outcry intensifies.
